violated_rules: G2 integer overflow in an exact arithmetic path

witness.failure: The i32 subtraction overflows before the cast in checked builds. Release wrapping does not make a checked-build panic acceptable.

repair: Use i32::abs_diff only after checking ordered endpoints; no signed subtraction is evaluated. Regression tests compare all 49 extreme endpoint pairs to an i64 oracle.
verification_status: 455-test initial/restored baselines passed. Old signed subtraction is killed by the concrete overflow regression. The unique typed-error candidate is killed in its successful replay.

refused_attempt_resolution.note: The failed historical receipt is retained unchanged; its refusal is not counted as a kill.
